# App interfaces (fresh build, v2)

Buildless static app in `dist/`. Plain `<script defer>` files, globals on `window`, no modules, no bundler, no external JS libraries. Load order (in `dist/index.html`):
`full-content.js` → `core.js` → `plan.js` → `motivation.js` → `lesson.js` → `app.js`.
CSS: `styles.css` (shell, owns the tokens) and `lesson.css` (player).

## Data: `window.GERMAN_FULL_DATA` (generated by `compile-course.py`)
```js
{ levels: <content/levels.json as is>,
  lessons:   [Lesson...],    // all levels, plan order
  skillDays: [SkillDay...],
  mocks:     [Mock...],
  resources: {videos:{...}, nicosWeg:{...}, links:{...}},   // from content/resources.json (only entries referenced + ok)
  partial: true|false }      // true when compiled with --partial (missing chapters allowed)
```
Lesson / SkillDay / Mock / Question shapes: see `active/content-contract.md`. `lesson.media.grammarVideos` etc. hold keys like `"yt:FuXxNSj_y5w"` → look them up in `resources.videos`.

## `window.KLEIN_CORE` (`core.js`, done; read it)
State shape, `migrate`, `qkey(owner,section,i)`, `attempt(state,key,q,value)` → `{correct,revealed,tries,showHint,canReveal,done}`, `reveal(state,key)`, `status`, `section(state,owner,name,questions,useLive?)` → `{done,right,total}`, `writingFeedback(free,text)`, `touchStreak`, `reviewWord`, `normalise`. **Hint after 2 wrong tries, then "Show answer" unlocks** (`HINT_AFTER`).

**First try is the score.** `state.answers` holds first tries only; `status(state,key)` and `section()` read it, and so do `stats`, `notYet` and plan.js. Everything after that lives in `state.practice` (same record shape, never scored, never touches `stats` or `notYet`):
- `retry(state,key)` ("Try again", unlimited): only when the question is answered or revealed; puts a fresh practice record so the input is empty again. `attempt`/`reveal` then work on the practice record.
- `live(state,key)` / `record(state,key)`: what is on screen now (practice record if there is one, else the first try). `section(..., true)` gives the redo score.
- `startRedo(state,lessonId,keys)` ("Redo lesson", finished lessons only, any number of times): sets `lessons[id].redo=true`, `step=0`, fresh practice records for every question key (`GERMAN_PLAYER.lessonKeys(lesson)`). `completedAt`, `completedOnDay` and `answers` never change.
- `endRedo(state,lessonId)`: `redo=false`, drops that lesson's practice records.
- Migration: `practice` and `lessons[id].redo` are optional; old v2 saves load with `practice:{}` and `redo:false`. Self-check: `node tests/player.cjs`.
Section names used in qkeys (internal; the learner sees "New sentence on your own" for `blind`, "Quiz" for `check`, "Practice" for skill days, "Review" for recall/review): `drills`, `blind`, `check` (owner = lesson id); `reading`, `listening`, `writing` (owner = skill-day id); `mock-<sectionIndex>` (owner = mock id); `review` (owner = `day-<n>`).

## `window.GERMAN_PLAN` (`plan.js`)
```js
build(data) -> plan = {
  days: [Day...],                         // 156 for the full course; fewer when data.partial
  lessonById, skillDayById, mockById,     // Maps
  dayOfLesson: Map(lessonId -> day n) }
Day = { n, week, dayInWeek /*1..6*/, level, kind: 'learn'|'review'|'mock'|'buffer',
        title, minutes, chapter /*learn*/, lessonIds /*learn: 3*/, skillDayId /*learn*/,
        mockId /*mock*/, reviewOf /*review: lessonIds of that week's learn days*/, plattform /*bool*/ ,
        available /*false if its content is not written yet*/ }
dueRecall(plan, state, n) -> [{key:'<lessonId>@<rung>', lessonId, rung, question}]   // rungs from levels.reviewLadder, counted in plan days after lesson.completedOnDay; question = lesson.retrieval[rung]; excludes passed ones
reviewSet(plan, state, n) -> [{key, question, from}]   // review/buffer day: 2 check questions per lesson of reviewOf + every notYet question from those lessons, grammar first, max 40
dayParts(plan, state, n) -> [{kind:'recall'|'lesson'|'skills'|'review'|'mock', id, title, done}]
dayDone(plan, state, n) -> bool
completeLesson(plan, state, lessonId, now) -> bool   // only if drills, blind and check are all done (correct or revealed); sets completedAt + completedOnDay = current day
finishDay(plan, state, n, now) -> bool   // only if dayDone; sets days[n].doneAt, moves position.day to n+1 (never backwards); idempotent
markRecall(state, key, passed, revealed, now)
stats(plan, state) -> {daysDone, lessonsDone, wordsSeen, accuracy, byLevel:{a1:{done,total}...}, week}
```
Missed calendar days never matter: day n+1 unlocks when day n is finished. Day 7 of a week is rest and is not in `days`.

## `window.GERMAN_MOTIVATION` (`motivation.js`, shell agent)
```js
start(api)      // api = {getState, toast(msg)}; while a lesson screen is open and settings.reminders, every settings.interval minutes show a rotating encouraging toast (uses live stats, e.g. "12 right so far"); pauses when the tab is hidden; if Notification permission is granted and the tab is hidden, uses a browser notification instead
stop()
celebrate(kind, info)  // kind: 'lesson'|'day'|'week'|'level'; info: {title, right, total, streak}; full-screen "wow" overlay with score + one line of what was learned + streak; confetti unless settings.reduced or prefers-reduced-motion; skipped if !settings.celebrate; closes on click/Enter/Escape; returns a Promise resolved on close
```

## `window.GERMAN_PLAYER` (`lesson.js`, player agent)
Every mount renders into `el`, binds its own events (event delegation on `el`), and calls `api.save()` after every state change.
```js
mountLesson(el, lesson, api)      // phases shown as a stepper: Start → Learn (every card, one per screen) → Drills → New sentence → Quiz → Speak → Words → Done; resumes at state.lessons[id].step
                                  // summary: "Finish Lesson 2 of 3 →"; on a finished lesson "Redo lesson" (startRedo) and, while redoing, "Finish redo →" (onDone({redo:true}))
mountSkillDay(el, skillDay, api)  // reading (text + glossary + 10 q) → listening (text-to-speech play/slow/replay, script hidden until answered or revealed, 10 q) → writing (10 items + free text with model + checks)
mountRecall(el, items, api)       // dueRecall or reviewSet items, one at a time
mountMock(el, mock, api)          // sections in order, score per section at the end, honest wording ("practice mock")
renderQuestion(q, key, state, opt?) -> html   // shared widget; choice buttons (keys 1-4), build (tap tokens), type (input, Enter); after 2 wrong: hint + "Show answer" button;
                                  // after answer/reveal: explanation + "Try again" (retry) + labelled next button (opt.next, e.g. "Next question", "Next: Quiz")
videoHtml(key, resources) -> html // 16:9 youtube-nocookie iframe (loading=lazy) + plain YouTube link; '' for an unknown id
lessonKeys(lesson) -> [qkey]      // every scored question key of a lesson (drills, blind, check)
api = { getState(), save(), core: KLEIN_CORE, plan, data, resources: data.resources,
        celebrate(kind, info) -> Promise, onDone(result), onExit(), speak(text, rate), dayN }
```
Teaching cards (v2.1, all before any question): one card per screen, big type. Order on a card: `body` → visual box (`parts` as colour chips with a legend of the roles used: subject/verb/object/ending/other → tokens `--r-*`; `steps` revealed one line at a time with "Next step (2 of 3)", the screen's Next stays disabled until all lines show; `table`, cells may be `{t,g}` for gender colour) → `examples` (de + listen button, en, why). Card 1 also carries the grammar video(s) and "Words about grammar"; the last card carries the common mistake. Cards without steps/parts (older content) render body, table and examples only.
Labels: every next button names where it goes ("Start learning", "Next: Drills →", "Next question →", "Finish Lesson 2 of 3 →", "Finish Practice →"). In normal mode a question blocks Next until its first try is done; after "Try again" a "Skip" button lets the learner move on. In a redo every question must be answered again.
Grammar video: `https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/<id>` in a 16:9 `<iframe loading="lazy" allowfullscreen>` with title; below it a plain link to the YouTube page (offline fallback). Nicos Weg + practice links open in a new tab (`rel="noopener"`).

## Shell (`app.js`, shell agent)
Storage key `klein-german-v1` (never rename). On load: `KLEIN_CORE.migrate(localStorage value, levels.planId)`; if `backup` is non-null and `german-progress-v1-backup` is empty, store the raw old value there first. All localStorage access in try/catch.
Hash routes: `#/home` (default), `#/chapters[/<level>[/<chapter>]]`, `#/day/<n>`, `#/lesson/<id>`, `#/skills/<id>`, `#/recall/<n>`, `#/review/<n>`, `#/mock/<id>`, `#/progress`, `#/grammar` (core tables with embedded videos, or "Video coming soon"; plus lesson grammar, searchable), `#/words`, `#/settings`. Old `#/today` and `#/plan` links map to home and chapters.

Layout (laptop only, 1280–1600px; no phone layout, no bottom nav):
- Fixed left sidebar on every screen, lessons included: Home, Chapters, Grammar, Words, Progress, Settings; current level/chapter and streak at the bottom.
- Sticky breadcrumb bar on every screen: `A1 › Ch 1 Guten Tag! › Day 1 › Lesson 2 of 3` (level → `#/chapters/a1`, chapter → `#/chapters/a1/1`, day → `#/day/n`). Learn days are numbered inside their chapter; review/mock days show as "Week 3 review" / "Practice mock". "Back" always links to the crumb one level up (top-level pages go back to Home).
- Home: where you are (level, chapter, day), three progress bars (level days, chapter lessons, today's parts), ONE big next-step button that names its target ("Start Lesson 2 of 3: du or Sie? →", "Go to Practice →", "Start quick Review →", "Finish Day 1 →") with one line of why, then today's parts. A day with `available:false` shows "Coming soon" instead of the button.
- Chapters: level tabs, then each chapter (collapsible, current one open) → its days (Done / Today / Open / Locked / Coming soon) → lessons + Practice with ticks; finished lessons have "Redo lesson". Review and mock days are listed after the chapters.
- Finishing a lesson celebrates once and goes Home; finishing a redo or reopening a finished lesson goes back to its day. "Save & pause" goes to the day.

## Look
Pure black UI. Tokens (defined in `styles.css :root`, used by both CSS files):
`--bg:#000; --surface:#0c0c0e; --surface-2:#17171b; --line:#2a2a30; --ink:#f6f4ef; --sub:#b4b1b9; --muted:#85828c; --ok:#5fd38d; --bad:#ff6b6b; --warn:#ffc857; --m --f --n --pl` (gender); `--radius:14px; --side:252px; --crumb-h:60px`.
Also `--accent:#ffd43b` (primary buttons, current step), sentence-part roles `--r-subject --r-verb --r-object --r-ending --r-other`, fonts Bricolage Grotesque (display) + Figtree (text) from Google Fonts with system fallbacks (offline still works).
ADHD rules: one activity on screen at a time, big targets (≥44px), phase stepper + progress bar per activity ("Question 4 of 10"), "Save & pause" always visible, no walls of text, keyboard friendly, laptop widths only, `prefers-reduced-motion` and the in-app reduced-motion setting respected (only small fades).

## Player v2.2: step bar, reset, `more`
- Step bar (lesson, practice): each step is a `<button data-act="phase">` jumping to the first screen of that step; current has `aria-current="step"`. Skipped questions stay open (first try is still pending). Browser Back leaves the page as before; in-app Back moves one screen.
- `KLEIN_CORE.resetKeys(state,keys)`: puts finished (or practising) questions into `state.practice` as fresh entries. Never touches `answers`, `stats`, `notYet`, `completedAt`, `completedOnDay`. Unanswered questions are skipped so their first try still counts.
- Reset controls: "Reset answers" per section (Drills, New sentence, Quiz; Practice Reading/Listening/Writing) and "Start lesson over" / "Start practice over" in the header; both confirm in-page and say "Your first score stays saved". Screens carry `reset:{name,keys}`; `engine` cfg takes `over:{label,keys()}`.
- Card field `more` (string, up to 150 words): button "Explain it more simply" (`aria-expanded`) opens it in place.
